_help.about: Add-ons listed on ZapPopPop > Modules > Add-ons. An add-on is a normal WordPress plugin; ZapPopPop only links to WordPress's own install and activate screens. Nothing is downloaded by ZapPopPop itself. The list is empty until add-ons are published.
_help.fields: slug = plugin slug (WordPress.org slug for kind wporg), file = folder/main-file.php as WordPress lists it, name (max 60), description (max 200), kind = wporg (Install button uses WordPress) or link (Get add-on opens url in a new tab; https only), url = only for kind link, icon = a dashicons class such as dashicons-cart, badge = short label (max 12).
_help.note: JSON does not allow comments or trailing commas. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored. Plugins can also add entries with the zappoppop_addon_catalog filter.
